description:
modules/traegerview — GET /traeger/reports/key-date with a template of every
section (#4716, ADR 0242): the Träger row, the school IDs of the Träger, the
report template, the school rows, the roster on the key date, the child of
each approved enrollment with the running phases, the care offering
bookings of the key date, the staff, the check-ins of the absence window,
the status days of the window and the waiting and waitlisted children for
the whole school set in one administrative transaction. Flat in the number
of schools.
